name: codex-plugin
description: Unofficial Lunch Money plugin for exploring your spending, budgets, and balances. Read-only access.

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial plugin for read-only access to Lunch Money
interface.longDescription: Ask about your spending, budgets, recurring expenses, and account balances in conversation. This unofficial plugin can read your Lunch Money data but cannot change financial records or move money. Independently developed by Oliver Newth; not affiliated with or endorsed by Lunch Money. Sign in, then enter your API token on the secure connection page, never in chat.
defaultPrompt: How does my spending compare with my budget?
What recurring expenses do I have?
